releases.name: Open BIM Studio 2026.47.0 — Linux preview (unsigned)
changes: Drawings: hidden-line plan, section and elevation projection, cropped and duplicated sections, details, dimension chains and labels that keep clear of each other, sheets with title blocks, PDF and DXF/DWG output.

Steel: columns, beams and catalogue profiles; end plate, fin plate, double cleat, splice, gusset, end cap and base plate connections with bolts, welds and copes. A recipe connection is now parametric: its plates and bolts follow the profiles of its members until a part is edited by hand. A beam cut up to 30 mm short of its support makes a joint, and a refused joint says why.
Speed: selecting, dragging, undo, the section box and edits in the 3D view no longer rebuild the whole model.
A section or detail of a model without walls or floors (a steel frame) is shown on screen.
IFC import of B-rep walls, beams and steel profiles as native elements; a command line of English sentences; an automation API and MCP server.

releases.name: Open BIM Studio 0.1 — Preview
changes: Parametric reinforcement cages, bars, meshes and area reinforcement.
Lightweight line display for reinforcement by default. Diameter display is available through Graphics > Rebar with diameter.

Reinforcement enclosed in supported opaque slab hosts is omitted from the GPU upload. Selecting the host/reinforcement or using wireframe/section box reveals it again. Sloped, concave and unsupported layered hosts stay visible.
More compact UI with the duplicate top title row removed.
Pan/shader correction, selectable grid heads and complete mullion outlines.
Reinforcement notation, schedules and example models.
Storey isolation also hides reinforcement; disable isolation to inspect it.
Dense reinforcement annotations on the example plan can overlap and need manual layout refinement. The example sheets are demonstration drawings.
